title: Far-right settlers divert West Bank spring water as Israel backs heritage site takeovers
detail: Far-right Israeli settlers have been diverting water from West Bank springs, cutting off Palestinian access, while the Israeli government backs settler takeovers of sites designated as cultural heritage, according to AP News reporting.

title: UN identifies 214 firms linked to Israeli settlements in the West Bank
detail: The United Nations has identified 214 companies with links to Israeli settlements in the West Bank, renewing international scrutiny of economic activity in occupied Palestinian territory.

title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian in Gaza, arrest four farmers in West Bank
detail: Israeli forces killed a Palestinian in Gaza and arrested four farmers in the West Bank, continuing military operations across occupied territories amid ongoing ceasefire violations.
